name: koto-server
description: Koto's server: transcription with Sarvam Saaras v4, optional tidy-up with Gemini, and cloud backup to R2.

KOTO_ACCESS_KEY.description: A long random password that only your copy of Koto knows, at least 16 characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, then type it into Koto: Settings, Server, Access key.

BACKUPS.description: Where cloud backups of your voice notes and history are kept. R2's free tier covers 10 GB.
